title: 第13章 凝火种剑老自叹第14章 虚惊一场厉秋雨
content_zh:
谢清影看着那处洞穴，里面啥也没有，有的只是那紫色的火焰，他虽然实力较高，但幽冥莲心火灼烧的是灵魂，他也不敢靠近。
“我也不知道，刚刚过来就看到了，除了热什么都没有......”
林玄平淡说道，毕竟刚刚这株异种幽冥莲已经被剑老吸收了最精华的部分。
谢清影也不再纠结，看着林玄笑呵呵道：
“刚刚我进来，看到三阶碧潭幽蟒的尸体断成了两截......看来师弟深藏不露啊！”
“在剑道上面偶有所得，比不得谢师兄。”林玄谦虚一笑，心中盼着谢清影这家伙到底什么时候走。
谢清影折扇一收，变得正经起来说道：“林玄师弟，我已从祝师妹那里得知，这碧潭幽蟒均是被你所斩杀，是你救下了她。但是除了这蟒尸之外，还有三位师弟师妹的尸体......”
“师兄放心，待我调息完后，会回去说明情况。”林玄点头说道，他必须后走，留下调息只是借口罢了。
“不，这些我自会去说明。你只需要尽快回去即可，这里的一切，我会向副门主如实禀告。”
说完，谢清影便神龙见首不见尾的消失在甬道内。
......
谢清影消失，并未要求自己及时跟他回去，林玄呼出一口气，这时候剑老的魂体也出现。
紧接着，在剑老的要求之下。
林玄咬了咬牙，开始进入紫色火焰中心，那种灵魂灼烧的剧痛传来，林玄不由得捂住了脑袋。
“啊！！！！”
“小子！坚持住，只有你的灵魂强度适应了幽冥莲心火之后，才能把它炼化成为本命火焰，运转刚刚我传给你的《火心诀》。”
剑老的声音在一旁不断传来。
林玄闭着眼睛，面部表情皱成了一捆麻绳，只有一个念头，那就是运转着《火心诀》。
渐渐的，紫色火焰开始焚烧林玄的衣物，很快林玄就全身一丝不挂。
“呵，好小子本钱还不小......”

剑老轻呵一声。
大概过了半刻钟之后，林玄渐渐感觉自己没那么难受了。
“生死关已经过了，不愧是能让九劫剑塔认主的存在，这毅力与韧性都是极佳！”
剑老看着林玄连连点头，露出赞赏的表情，他刚刚还是有点担心林玄可能会被幽冥莲心火烧的魂飞魄散，毕竟强行吸纳本命火焰的难度是十万不存一。
若不是剑老知道林玄身为九劫剑塔之主，是根本不会让他去冒险的。
时间一分一秒的过去，林玄感觉到自己已经差不多适应了幽冥莲心火的灼烧，便开口询问道：
“剑老，我应该已经适应了，接下来怎么办？”
“放开身上所有的防御，任由幽冥莲心火侵蚀你的身体，当你感觉到极限时，再运转《火心诀》，对体内的幽冥莲心火进行压缩！吸纳！”
“如此反复！”
在剑老的指导下，林玄直接放开了防御，灵气屏障去掉，甚至连《火心诀》都不运转。
content_en:
Xie Qingying looked at the cave. There was nothing in it, only the purple flames. Although he was stronger, the Nether Lotus Heart Fire burned his soul, and he did not dare to get close.
"I don't know. I just came here and saw that there was nothing but heat..."
Lin Xuan said calmly, after all, the best part of the alien Nether Lotus had just been absorbed by Jian Lao.
Xie Qingying no longer hesitated, looked at Lin Xuan and said with a smile:
"I just came in and saw the body of the third-order Bitan Youbo python broken into two pieces... It seems that the junior brother is hiding something secretly!"
"What I have gained occasionally in the way of swordsmanship is nothing compared to thanking my senior brother." Lin Xuan smiled modestly, hoping in his heart when Xie Qingying would leave.
Xie Qingying put away her folding fan and became serious and said: "Junior Brother Lin Xuan, I have learned from Junior Sister Zhu that this Bitan Nether Python was killed by you, and it was you who saved her. But in addition to this python corpse, there are also the corpses of three junior brothers and sisters..."
"Senior brother, don't worry. After I finish adjusting my breath, I will go back and explain the situation." Lin Xuan nodded and said, he had to leave, leaving behind to adjust his breath was just an excuse.
"No, I will explain these myself. You just need to go back as soon as possible. I will truthfully report everything here to the deputy sect leader."
After saying that, Xie Qingying disappeared into the corridor like a dragon.
...
Xie Qingying disappeared and did not ask herself to go back with him in time. Lin Xuan breathed out, and at this time Jian Lao's soul also appeared.
Immediately afterwards, at the request of Jian Lao.
Lin Xuan gritted his teeth and began to enter the center of the purple flame. The soul-burning pain came, and Lin Xuan couldn't help but cover his head.
"Ah!!!!"
"Boy! Hold on, only after your soul strength adapts to the Netherworld Lotus Heart Fire can you refine it into your natal flame and run the "Fire Heart Art" I just passed on to you."
Jian Lao's voice kept coming from the side.
Lin Xuan closed his eyes, his facial expression wrinkled into a bundle of hemp rope, and had only one thought, which was to run the "Fire Heart Art".
Gradually, the purple flames began to burn Lin Xuan's clothes, and soon Lin Xuan was completely naked.
"Haha, this good boy has quite a lot of money..."
Jian Lao chuckled softly.
After about half a quarter of an hour, Lin Xuan gradually felt less uncomfortable.
"The barrier of life and death has passed. He is worthy of being recognized as the master of the Nine Tribulations Sword Tower. His perseverance and resilience are both excellent!"
Jian Lao watched Lin Xuan nod his head repeatedly with an expression of appreciation. He was still a little worried that Lin Xuan might be burned to death by the Netherworld Lotus Heart. After all, it is extremely difficult to forcibly absorb the natal flame.
If Jian Lao hadn't known that Lin Xuan was the master of the Nine Tribulations Sword Tower, he wouldn't have let him take the risk.
As time passed, Lin Xuan felt that he had almost adapted to the burning of Nether Lotus Heart Fire, so he asked:
"Jian Lao, I should have adapted to it, what should I do next?"
"Let go of all defenses on your body and let the Nether Lotus Heart Fire erode your body. When you feel the limit, run the "Fire Heart Art" to compress the Nether Lotus Heart Fire in your body! Absorb it!"
"Repeatedly!"
Under Jian Lao's guidance, Lin Xuan directly let go of his defenses, removed the aura barrier, and even the "Fire Heart Technique" stopped functioning.
